## Key Skills & Expertise

- Automation QA: Playwright, Cypress, Vitest, Jest, Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions).
- Frontend & Fullstack: SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 (Runes), TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3, TailwindCSS, REST APIs.
- AI & LLM Systems: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/LLMO), AI agent workflows, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines.
- Standards & Quality: WCAG accessibility, web performance optimization (Core Web Vitals), Observability & Sentry integration.
